input_messages.content: Hi, I need to exchange a couple of tea kettles from my recent order. Can you help me with that?
I actually don’t remember which email I used, but my name is Aarav Anderson and my zip code is 19031. Will that work?
Yeah, I have the order number—it’s W4316152. That’s the one with the tea kettles I want to exchange.

Okay, so I want to exchange both tea kettles, but for different things.

For the first one, I want to swap it for a ceramic tea kettle that works on a gas stove.

For the second one, I want to exchange it for a tea kettle that’s 1.5 liters and also works on a gas stove.

As for the payment, I’d rather just use the same gift card if there’s any price difference. Is that possible?

Wait, just to be clear—I want the first one to be ceramic and for gas, but I didn’t mention the size. The second one should be 1.5 liters and for gas, but I didn’t say it has to be glass. I just want the 1.5-liter one for gas, whatever material is standard.

And yes, I want to use my gift card for any price difference. Can you double-check that before you go ahead?
Yes, that matches what I want. Please go ahead with the exchange.
Ugh, that’s annoying. I really wanted to just use the gift card. Can you tell me how much extra I’d have to pay? I want to know before I decide what to do.
Alright, I guess I’ll use my credit card for the $4.10. What do you need from me to do that?
Just use the default credit card you have on file. Go ahead and process the exchange.
Oh, that’s not what I expected. I thought I could use both. Fine, just charge the whole $21.10 to my default credit card. Let’s just get this done.
I’m not sure which card is on file, honestly. I don’t have the numbers handy right now—it’s all a bit messy. Can you just tell me what options you see for cards on my account?
Yeah, go ahead and transfer me to someone who can help with that. Thanks.
